title: マイルの先にあるもの

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And now to introduce the Umamusume in the center! With stellar performances in sprint, mile, and medium-distance races…

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And countless G1 victories! Her gallant running has captivated audiences everywhere—ladies and gentlemen, I give you Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy! I'm here to make y'all happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After initially aiming to become Umamusume of the Year running only sprint and mile races, Taiki Shuttle has improved far beyond my expectations…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No longer walled in by distance, she embarks for new horizons.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! We're finally back at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You said it! I'm just glad I could make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… Ah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that you, Suzuka? You restin' up after the race?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess so. But more than that, I needed to make sure it was there…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The place I'd like to see.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The place you'd like to see? You mean…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The view from the lead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I've never stopped running for it, and yet I still haven't reached it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm always looking at your back instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One excels in mile races. The other excels in medium-distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Taiki Shuttle has shown tremendous growth and successfully emerged victorious into medium-distance territory.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Are you happy, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm real happy I got to go head-to-head with ya, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course, I love spendin' time with my friends 'n' family. That makes me plenty happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But it ain't the same. This is happiness that gets my heart pumpin' hot.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's a happiness I can't get nowhere else… Do you feel it too, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I've come to realize something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The view from up front, where I'm truly alone…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not a place I can reach on my own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You keep running ahead of me… and that makes me want to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No… I will surpass you. I'll show you that I can.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's why… I think this situation is okay for me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, in that case, it's okay for me too! I just wanna take ya on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I know just how strong ya are, Suzuka—stronger than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's keep this happiness pipin' hot!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll promise you this. I won't give up on taking the lead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two have forged a bond, having grown closer over their countless battles. I don't want to miss a single moment from here.
